WITH TEMP_CUR AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A, 0)), 0) AMOUNT FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{startDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('1102', '1111', '1112', '1113', '1114', '1115', '1116') AND INFO.INDUSTRY = '10' ), TEMP_LAST AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A, 0)), 0) AMOUNT FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('1102', '1111', '1112', '1113', '1114', '1115', '1116') AND INFO.INDUSTRY = '10' ) SELECT 'thamt1_3_4' AS propertycode, TC.AMOUNT AS sessionendNum, TL.AMOUNT AS lastSessionendNum FROM TEMP_CUR TC, TEMP_LAST TL

SELECT 'samt1_3' propertycode, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A), 0) FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{startDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND CMAP.ASSETTYPE = '12' AND FPT.TYPE_12 = '106' ) AS nonsStandardAmount, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A), 0) FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND CMAP.ASSETTYPE = '12' AND FPT.TYPE_12 = '106' ) AS lastNonsStandardAmount, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A), 0) FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{startDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND CMAP.ASSETTYPE = '12' AND FPT.TYPE_12 != '106' ) AS otherAmount, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A), 0) FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND CMAP.ASSETTYPE = '12' AND FPT.TYPE_12 != '106' ) AS lastOtherAmount FROM DUAL

select CM.ASSET_CODE assetcode,sum(CM.ASSETVALUE_A) sessionendNum from CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION cm left join CHB_ASSET_INFO ca on CM.ASSET_CODE=CA.ASSET_CODE and CA.STATUS !='D' where CA.ASSET_TYPE='12' and CM.ENDDATE=#{endDate, jdbcType = DATE} and CM.ASSETVALUE_A !=0 group by CM.ASSET_CODE
